name: Meshy
tagline: Text and image to high-quality 3D models
description: Meshy generates production-ready 3D meshes from text prompts or reference images, with PBR textures and rigging support. Used by indie game developers, AR/VR creators, and product designers to skip the early modelling stage. Outputs export to GLB, FBX, OBJ, and USDZ for downstream tooling.
pricingDetails: Free: 200 credits/month. Pro: $20/month. Max: $60/month. Studio: $120/month. Enterprise: custom.
